title: 循環果實
prompt: A single game-item icon illustration of one plump coral-red fruit with a single broad sage-green leaf and short warm-brown stem, cradled on the lower-left side by ONE thick honey-gold circular return arrow with a big rounded arrowhead. The fruit is the main object, the curved arrow is the only supporting detail, and the gap inside the loop stays open and readable. Read as automated feeding or repeat cycle. No bowl, no pot, no gear, no hands, no bite marks, no shine. Match the rendering of the TWO ATTACHED approved references, the golden planter and red mushroom: soft matte clay-like 3D, plump simple rounded volumes, gentle top-left key light, softly painted shading and a faint highlight, crisp clean silhouette with NO outline stroke and no texture noise. Palette: honey-gold #F5C55A, sage green, warm brown, cream #FFF1DB, coral red #F36C63 as the single accent. Not shiny metal, not plastic. One main object with at most one or two supporting details, broad shapes that read at 80px. Centered on a square transparent canvas, object fills about 84%, 8% safe margin all sides, no ground plane, no cast shadow outside object except faint contact shadow. Requested 1254x1254 RGBA PNG. NO faces, eyes, mouths, hands, arms, characters, letters, numbers, text, text-like marks, sparkles, glitter, reflections, thick dark outlines, sticker borders, flat vector, line-art or emoji style. The references are for STYLE ONLY: do NOT draw their pot or downward arrow unless explicitly requested. Only one isolated icon; no comparison sheet.
